title: One scan, one system
desc: A PET scan sees every organ's sugar use at once. 658 scans make a network of organs that thins and tips towards a few hubs as health erodes; the aim is to read one scan against such a network.
page: One scan, one system: the body as a metabolic network
sub: the body as a metabolic network
aria: Interactive 3D story of whole-body PET scans and the network of the organs' metabolism
